{{Quote|Admiral Tyzen is expected to comment later today, but we've already seen an escalated response level.|A reporter, regarding the Imperial response to the firebombing at the Palmo Naval Terminal|<ref name="Messenger" />}}
'''Tyzen''' was an [[Imperial officer]] who held the [[military rank|rank]] of [[admiral]] in the [[Galactic Empire]] in [[2 BBY]]. That [[standard year|year]], following a [[Firebombing at the Imperial Naval Terminal|firebombing]] of the [[Imperial Naval Terminal]] in [[Palmo]],<ref name="Messenger" /> the [[capital]] [[city]] of the [[Colonies]] [[planet]] [[Ghorman]],<ref name="OYL">{{Andor|One Year Later}}</ref> a [[Unidentified reporter 2|reporter]] stated in a broadcast that Tyzen was expected to make a statement on the incident.<ref name="Messenger" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyzen was mentioned in "[[Messenger]],"<ref name="Messenger" /> the seventh episode in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Companion">{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}}</ref>
